title: Verbs
oneLiner: Every HSK 3.0 (2026) headword tagged V (verb), across all bands.
description: Every verb in the HSK 3.0 (2026) list. Membership is the part-of-speech column of the HSK 3.0 (2026) word list, read as an any-tag match: a word tagged 'V/N' belongs to both the verb pack and the noun pack. The pack spans every band, so it makes no band-closure claim; each word keeps its own band label.
rationale: Verbs are where Mandarin grammar lives, and the class most worth drilling with sentences rather than glosses.

provenance.rule: Any part-of-speech tag on the headword matches one of 'v', 'verb' (case-insensitive, slash-separated tags split first).
provenance.bands: HSK 3.0 (2026) official word list, effective 1 July 2026
provenance.definitions: carried by the canon; not duplicated into this pack
